verdict.rationale: Developer docs show that Canva designs have comments: you can add comments to designs (MCP), sync comments via the Connect APIs, and receive and reply to Canva comments from other platforms. This confirms commenting and threaded replies exist, but nothing in the pack documents mentioning teammates or resolving threads. Missing for 10: evidence of @mentioning teammates, thread resolution, first-party docs on in-editor commenting for reviewers (current evidence is developer/API-oriented), independent or hands-on corroboration.
